description: Mailbox housekeeping in the authenticated business mailbox, only when the user asks: mark messages read or unread, archive or unarchive. Sends nothing and deletes nothing. mark_read/mark_unread apply to received messages among the ids (sent mail has no read state). archive/unarchive move the whole conversation with each message’s other party, like the dashboard does. Every id must come from list_business_emails or get_business_email; one unknown or hidden id (MAIL_NOT_FOUND) rejects the whole call without changing anything. Takes 1–50 ids per call; any beyond 50 are returned as skipped. Returns the ids actually changed in updated (empty when they already were in that state). MAIL_UPDATE_REQUIRED means the business website needs its next update before this works.
name: update_business_emails
